stages.description: Define the research question and completion scope

gates.criterion: A research question and positive/negative/inconclusive outcome definitions are delivered for review

stages.description: Map prior work and unresolved questions

gates.criterion: Sources read, search limitations and competing explanations are documented
Metrics, baselines, material selection, exclusions and stopping conditions are documented
An independent assignment reviews whether the planned observations distinguish the hypotheses

stages.description: Prepare the environment and run a small pilot

gates.criterion: Protected measurement exists for the pilot, including valid negative outcomes

stages.description: Run the stated validation and analyze results

gates.criterion: Protected measurement exists for the validation candidate
Independent execution or material and scope checks have been supplied through a trusted event

stages.description: Package supported claims and reproduction guidance

gates.criterion: Evidence, limitations and reproduction instructions are delivered
The original protected completion predicate accepts this candidate
